paragraphs: A full-stack web application where doctors register profiles, patients browse and book consultations, and doctors can be reached directly via WhatsApp for emergencies.
Built as a learning project covering: authentication, CRUD operations, file uploads, role-based access, relational data, and responsive UI.
Related docs: SCALING.md — the ordered scale-up plan (Render → WebSockets → Atlas) and upgrade triggers for when real traffic arrives.
features: Doctor and patient registration with role-based access

Patient ID: every patient gets a short, human-readable id (e.g. PT000123) at registration — shown in their Account Settings, on the doctor's appointment card, Patient Reports, Prescriptions, and the downloadable…

Bilingual patient experience (English / हिंदी): a prominent language toggle (on the home page, booking flow, and "Get the App" page) whose choice is remembered across visits and carries through the whole patient journey…
Search-first home page (like Practo/1mg): the symptom search is the hero, with the specialization grid, "How it works", real patient reviews, and FAQ below
Local SEO landing pages: /specialization/:slug and /specialization/:slug/:city ("Best Dermatologists in Rishikesh"), driven by real doctor-city data so no empty "doorway" pages are created

whatItDoes.text: A full-stack web application where doctors register profiles, patients browse and book consultations, and doctors can be reached directly via WhatsApp for emergencies.

requirements.text: The WhatsApp option needs no paid API and reaches phone-only doctors the email can't
Login via phone (default) OR email (toggle switch)
Show/hide password toggle on login and registration pages (crisp SVG icon, not emoji — renders consistently across platforms)
"I Have Paid" quick confirmation + optional receipt upload
